headline: Chile Think Tank CEP Proposes Partial Ownership Opening for Codelco
summary: Chile's Centro de Estudios Públicos (CEP) proposed eight reform measures for state copper giant Codelco, including evaluating a partial private listing modelled on Norway's Equinor.
why: Codelco is the world's largest copper mining company, and its capital structure directly affects sovereign finances and worldwide copper mine supply.

impacts.name: Codelco
impacts.why: Policy proposal recommends evaluating partial equity opening to finance critical copper investments.
